summary: Prudential plc filed a Form 6-K on September 1, 2026, disclosing routine repurchases of its own ordinary shares under an existing buy-back program announced January 6, 2026. From August 24-28, 2026, Prudential purchased approximately 1.89 million shares at prices between 10.06 and 10.51 GBP per share through JP Morgan Securities plc. The company intends to cancel the repurchased shares, reducing share count. Since program inception, Prudential has repurchased about 58.75 million shares at a weighted average price of 1,083.4152p. This is a standard issuer buy-back disclosure, not an event-driven special situation; the ongoing program represents routine capital return to shareholders, and there are no unusual terms or imminent strategic implications to analyze as a special-situation risk-arb event.
